conventions.foreign_keys: PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; child rows are deleted with their user (ON DELETE CASCADE)

tables.name: users
tables.description: One row per account. MVP seeds a single 'user'; Step 10 stores the Clerk user id in username.

tables.name: baseline_resumes
tables.description: The current baseline resume per user (at most one). Uploading replaces it.

tables.name: custom_resumes
tables.description: Download history: one row each time a custom resume is downloaded. The PDF is regenerated from content_md on re-download.

columns.name: style
columns.description: PDF style used at download time

tables.name: preferences
tables.description: User preferences as a JSON object (at most one row per user). Missing row means defaults.

notes.description: Anything else the AI should always consider

include_phone.description: Keep the phone number from the baseline in the generated resume

include_graduation_year.description: Keep the university graduation/completion year in the Education section

professional_years.description: Roles that ended within this many years go in Professional Experience (full detail)

earlier_years.description: Roles in the next this-many years go in Earlier Experience (one line each: role, company, years); older roles are left out; 0 = no Earlier Experience section

model.description: OpenRouter model used to generate the resume
